label: main season
summary: Recommend clearance for sign-off. E1 is an unverified database record of a past accident inside the area, classed as weak indirect evidence, but the national criteria make such a record a target for clearance after the first NTS visit and do not provide technical survey. The reported safe use and the survey team's observations do not remove that target; no direct evidence was reported.
flags: E1 has no date or other details, and its location has not been checked on the ground.
The survey team observed only paths and field edges; the dossier describes the area as 100% forest.
Three first-hand users report recurring safe use, but their periods cannot be linked to the undated database record.
Zone survey flag and priority are visit-planning information, not evidence.

checks.detail: Every item of the evidence log is in the register.
The national criteria provide no technical survey, so clearance takes its place; evidence to target: E1.

E1.quote: The national mine action database records one or more past landmine accidents inside this area.
E1.note: The database record is unverified: its date and other details are absent and its location has not been checked on the ground, so it suggests possible EO presence but does not confirm it.

E2.quote: The survey team walked the paths and field edges of the area and saw no items, signs, fencing or other marks of contamination.
E2.note: This is the survey team's own observation of no indicators on the paths and field edges it covered; it does not resolve the recorded accident, whose date and precise location are unknown.

E3.quote: the board has recorded no find or accident in the area in the 8 years she has held the post, and that families use land in the area every week.
E3.note: A first-hand community representative reports recurring land use and no recorded finds or accidents over eight years; the unknown date of the database record means this does not establish safe use after that record.

E4.quote: he has hunted and fished along the streams in the area every year for the past 10 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E4.note: This first-hand land user reports ten years of recurring use without findings or known accidents; the period cannot be linked to the undated database record.

E5.quote: he has cut firewood and timber in the area every year for the past 13 years, and has never found anything or heard of an accident there.
E5.note: This first-hand land user reports thirteen years of recurring use without findings or known accidents; the period cannot be linked to the undated database record.
